mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sheet_table (title, sheet_file, music_key, code_id, difficulty, comment_text, stroke) VALUES (#{title}, #{sheetFile}, #{musicKey}, #{codeId}, #{difficulty}, #{commentText}, #{stroke});
mapper.update: UPDATE sheet_table SET title = #{title}, sheet_file = #{sheetFile}, music_key = #{musicKey}, code_id = #{codeId}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, comment_text = #{commentText}, stroke = #{stroke} WHERE sheet_id = #{sheetId};
